title: Nice Attributes
description: This mod adds GUI to attributes
body:
This mod adds GUI to attributes!

![attributes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b2cad76b455c7d14ec8fbd29e61a57dbfd17c41a.png)

This mod adds an attribute menu, allowing you to customize each attribute for a player using a convenient menu rather than a command. You can also select the type (all players/only you) and reset values ​​to default.
